findings.description: Course filter regex injection risk: controllers/studentController.js line 60 constructs regex pattern from unescaped user input. Courses containing regex metacharacters (dots, brackets, plus, asterisk, parentheses) will cause incorrect matches or MongoDB errors. Escape the course parameter before constructing the regex pattern.

Age filter inputs allow negative values: public/index.html minAge and maxAge inputs lack min='0' attribute. Backend correctly validates and ignores negative values, but client-side validation should prevent submission for immediate user feedback.

No sorting stability guarantee: When multiple students share the same sort key value (e.g., same name or age), MongoDB doesn't guarantee consistent order without a secondary sort key. Paginating through sorted results might show the same record on different pages. Add secondary sort by _id for deterministic ordering.

Phase 4 roadmap inconsistency: README.md Project Roadmap marks 'Phase 4: Testing Infrastructure' as incomplete [ ] despite comprehensive test infrastructure being fully implemented and operational (Jest, Supertest, MongoDB Memory Server, 12 test suites, 185 tests, 94.57% coverage). Update the checkbox to [x].
